verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਚਲ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਖ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਚਲ ਆਵਈ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur charan saran chal jai sikh charan saran taa(n) kee jagat chal aaviee||

en.bdb: A Sikh who devotedly goes to the refuge of a True Guru, has the whole world falling at his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗਯਾ ਸਤਯ ਸਤਯ ਕਰ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਿਖਯ ਆਗਯਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur aagayaa satay satay kar maanai sikhay aagayaa taeh sagal sa(n)saar hitaaviee ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who abides by the command of his Guru, accepting it to be true; his command is loved by the whole world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੈ ਸਿਖ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sevaa bhai praan poojaa karai sikh sarab nidhaan agrabhaag liv laaviee ||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who serves his Guru with loving devotion at the cost of his life considering such service as worship, all the treasures are mute attendant before him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਖਯਾ ਦੀਖਯਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸ ਜਾਹਿ॥ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੀਖ ਸੁਨਤ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੮੭॥
verses.translit_en: satigur seekhayaa dheekhayaa hiradhai praves jaah|| taa kee seekh sunat param padh paaviee ||87||

en.bdb: A Sikh of the Guru who has the teachings and consecration of his Guru in his heart, listening to his teachings/sermons one can reach supreme spiritual state. (87)
